title: What If Lightning Vanished?
yt_title: What If Lightning Vanished From Earth? #shorts
description: Every second, dozens of lightning bolts reshape our atmosphere and fertilize the ground. Here is what would happen if the sky went permanently silent.

scenes.say: What if lightning completely vanished from planet Earth, and every violent thunderstorm went dead silent forever?
head: WHAT IF
LIGHTNING
*VANISHED?*

scenes.say: Right now, over forty lightning bolts strike the ground every second. In a flash, that number plunges to zero.
head: GLOBAL STRIKES
*PLUNGE TO*
ZERO
scenes.label: lightning strikes globally

scenes.say: Most people do not know that lightning rips apart atmospheric nitrogen molecules, raining down natural fertilizer for plant life.
Without these chemical strikes, wild soil would gradually starve, causing forests to wither and wild crop yields to plummet.
head: WILD SOILS
*BEGIN TO*
STARVE
scenes.label: natural soil nitrates

scenes.say: Lightning also generates reactive molecules that clean our skies, breaking down potent greenhouse gases like dangerous methane.
head: ATMOSPHERIC
*CLEANSING*
STOPS
scenes.label: air filtration

scenes.say: Without this atmospheric detergent, greenhouse pollutants would linger indefinitely, creating dense, toxic smog across the globe.
head: TOXIC GASES
*BUILD UP*
RAPIDLY

scenes.say: Massive rainstorms would still flood our cities, but thunder would soon become nothing more than an ancient forgotten myth.
head: A WORLD OF
*SILENT*
STORMS
scenes.label: SILENT SKIES

scenes.say: Over decades, agricultural systems would need artificial nitrogen supplements on a planetary scale just to prevent global starvation.
head: GLOBAL CROP
*COLLAPSE*
TIMELINE

scenes.say: Here is the shocking twist. Scientists believe ancient lightning strikes created the very amino acids that sparked all life on Earth.
Without that initial spark, humanity would never have existed in the first place. Welcome to Parallel Earth.
head: NOT JUST
*A WHAT IF*

scenes.say: Would you survive in this timeline? Follow for more.
head: WOULD YOU
SURVIVE IN THIS
*TIMELINE?*
